## Objectives

- Reach the bridge by the Dewdrop at dusk in [Fairy Forest](../maps/fairy_forest.md)
- Defeat 60 Creature of the High Shore or the Oaks ([Evil Eye](../monsters/evil_eye.md), [Curse Eye](../monsters/curse_eye.md), [Cold Eye](../monsters/cold_eye.md), [Sharpened Lupin](../monsters/sharpened_lupin.md), [Gloomfur Lupin](../monsters/gloomfur_lupin.md), [Surgeon Eye](../monsters/surgeon_eye.md))
